Restore refuses to overwrite configuration changed later
Backup journal cannot select arbitrary paths
TCP detection distinguishes listening and closed local test ports
Connection launch bypasses command shell and passes no password
Bundled official engine digest matches pinned release
Signed update verifies publisher key and detects altered payload/signature
Authenticated manifest still enforces product, version and file allowlist
Downloaded ZIP verifies digest and every extracted executable
ZIP traversal and undeclared files are rejected before escaping staging
Successful update preserves engine, device data and rollback backup
